# QS-CFW-5998-73 — Quality specification - track link CFW-5998-73 (15B37)
Revision: Rev B  
Supersedes: Rev A  
Plant: P2  
Parts: CFW-5998-73

## Scope
This quality specification applies to the manufactured track link CFW-5998-73 produced at Plant P2. It establishes acceptance criteria for hardness, bore dimensional tolerance, and maximum forging weight for finished track links prior to heat treatment confirmation, final inspection, and shipment.

## Requirements table
| Feature | Requirement | Acceptance |
|---|---|---|
| Hardness (as-measured) | 31-35 HRC | Pass if within range |
| Bore diameter tolerance | ±0.08 mm | Pass if bore measurement is within tolerance |
| Maximum forging weight | 4.8 kg | Pass if weight is less than or equal to maximum |

All values listed above apply to part CFW-5998-73. Material, heat-treatment sequence, and other production controls must ensure parts arrive at inspection meeting these requirements.

## Inspection method
- Hardness: Measure using a calibrated Rockwell hardness tester appropriate for HRC scale. Verify calibration status per lab procedures before use. Record the measured value on the inspection record for each sampled part.
- Bore diameter: Measure with calibrated bore gauge or internal micrometer capable of resolving the stated tolerance. Record actual bore dimension and compare to nominal drawing to confirm conformance with the stated tolerance.
- Weight: Weigh the forging on a calibrated balance. Record the measured mass and confirm it does not exceed the stated maximum forging weight.
- Acceptance is based solely on the recorded measurements compared to the Requirements table values.

## Nonconformance handling
- Parts failing any requirement in the Requirements table shall be segregated and identified to prevent use or shipment.
- Nonconforming parts require disposition via the documented nonconformance process. Root cause analysis and corrective action should be initiated to prevent recurrence.
- Rework is permitted only if documented procedures demonstrate restored conformity to the Requirements table values and authorized disposition is obtained prior to release.
